_comment: Phase 93a.2 externally-computed digest literals (tests-redteam.md P0-1/P0-2). Each digest was produced by hashing an independently-authored (clean-room, non-imported) canonicalizer's output with the external `shasum -a 256` tool, never by calling canonicalProgramDigest/canonicalProgramBytes from impl/src/program-ir. They pin exact canonical bytes so a canonicalization drift (code-point vs UTF-16 code-unit key sort, non-JCS number formatting, stray whitespace) fails these assertions even though the implementation would agree with itself. Preimages match the fixtures in phase93a-program-fixtures.mjs's programFixture() and the P93A2-R1 kitchen-sink Program.
_comment_93a3a: kitchenSinkProgramDigest/baseSourceProgramDigest/baseSourceOwnershipDigest were regenerated for 93a.3a rule 7 (the collect pinned-name back-port renames the shared collect-result schema from the arbitrary label 'fixture.collect_result' to its derivation-pinned 'baton.derived.<hash>' name, which shifts every Program's canonical schemas-array bytes since programFixture()'s default registry embeds it regardless of whether a given Program uses collect). Recomputed in-session with a standalone from-scratch canonicalizer (sort object keys by UTF-16 code unit, arrays in original order, JSON.stringify primitives -- deliberately not importing canonical-value.mjs) cross-checked against the implementation's own canonicalProgramDigest; not re-verified with a separate external clean-room tool, so flagged as a finding for an independent re-check.

nonBmpKeyVector._comment: Classic UTF-16 code-unit vs Unicode code-point sort divergence: U+10000 (surrogate pair D800,DC00) sorts BEFORE U+E000 under unsigned UTF-16 code-unit comparison (0xD800 < 0xE000), but AFTER it under full code-point comparison (0x10000 > 0xE000).
